summary: Better Home & Finance Holding Co filed an 8-K on October 8, 2026, disclosing that effective October 6, 2026, it amended its August 20, 2026 Rights Agreement with Computershare Trust Company, N.A. to accelerate the expiration of all outstanding stock purchase rights from the 2027 annual meeting to the close of business on October 6, 2026. The rights and Rights Agreement terminated, and a Certificate of Elimination eliminated the Series A Junior Participating Preferred Stock. No preferred shares were issued or outstanding. The filing concerns a rights plan termination rather than a transaction, with no price, premium, or advisor stated. Watch for any subsequent activist or takeover developments.
